entities.summary: Huoshenshan Hospital was an emergency specialty field hospital, built between 23 January and 2 February 2020, in response to the COVID-19 pandemic in China. The facility is located near Zhiyin Lake (知音湖) in the Caidian District, Wuhan, Hubei, China, next to the Wuhan Workers' Sanatorium (武汉职工疗养院), and is designed to treat people with COVID-19. The hospital has run under the jurisdiction and management of the People's Liberation Army since its completion. A second field hospital, Leishenshan Hospital, using the same design, opened on 8 February, A further sixteen other temporary treatment facilities were set up in converted buildings in Wuhan for isolation and treatment of COVID-19 cases.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Huoshenshan Hospital played a significant role in China's response to the COVID-19 pandemic, treating over 1 million patients and helping to mitigate the spread of the virus. Its design and implementation served as a model for subsequent field hospitals globally.
